canonical_path.task: Final Semantic production review of the complete reviewable frame set
canonical_path.input_authority: production_ledger current_candidate or approved_asset rows, with frame and frozen source bindings
canonical_path.critic_execution: frame_semantic_review.py runs bounded full-review shards, merges decisions, and runs global closure before candidate persistence
canonical_path.authoritative_output: meta/frame-semantic-review.json plus frame-semantic-candidate-attempt-N.json and frame-semantic-audit evidence
canonical_path.authority_effect: _apply_candidate_gate closes per-frame Candidate PASS/FAIL into production_ledger transitions, promotion, and lock; this is the canonical authority-bearing boundary
canonical_path.existing_semantic_verifier: frame_semantic_review.verify_episode validates persisted review evidence and bindings
consumers: episodes/_system/machine_gate.py check_production consumes verify_frame_semantic_episode errors as FAIL findings
episodes/_system/machine_action_executor.py final production action calls verify_episode and rejects invalid review
episodes/_system/final_candidate_snapshot.py verifies Final Semantic before snapshot build and includes the review evidence in the snapshot
release preflight and delivery consume the verified final candidate snapshot and Final Semantic evidence

authority_order: reviewable Candidate set and source bindings are assembled
existing Final Semantic model review runs and validates its Candidate
canonical candidate gate applies ledger PASS/FAIL and may promote/lock
machine gate, final snapshot, and release consumers validate the persisted result
shadow_boundary_observation: Any future advisory shadow must read the same frozen reviewable Candidate set and source bindings before the canonical authority-bearing ledger transition; it must not write review records, the production ledger, locks, gates, or snapshot state.
existing_final_semantic_critic: Already present as the canonical Final Semantic production reviewer; a P3 shadow would be an additional advisory comparison path, not a replacement for this reviewer.
